contract: Sahabat Belajar (SLB B-C Wijayakusumah) UI Design Contract (ui-design-contract.md). Direct role selection (Murid / Guru) and clean focused student & teacher login cards, zero emojis, zero buzzwords, sensory-safe tokens, WCAG AA/AAA.

accessibility.evidence: Verified with scripts/check-contrast.mjs passing WCAG AA (calm tokens) and AAA (high-contrast tokens). Skip link present, :focus-visible rings enforced, aria-describedby validation errors, >= 64px student keypad keys.

responsive.evidence: Role grid adjusts cleanly from 2-column desktop (max-width 680px) to 1-column mobile (<= 640px). Single login card (max-width 430px) centers cleanly on both desktop and mobile viewports without horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: Server-rendered Blade auth views render directly without async layout shift.

empty.evidence: Empty content states in student/admin pages remain clear with polite action links.

error.evidence: Auth alerts (.login-alert) and inline error text (.login-error) show soft amber feedback and clear recovery messages.

partial.reason: Authentication cards render complete forms atomically.

success.evidence: Successful student and teacher authentication redirects verified via PHPUnit AuthTest (8/8 passing).

permission.evidence: Role and guest middleware route redirects and 403 handler tested cleanly.

renderedEvidence.observation: Rendered auth.login-student shows clean Sahabat Belajar school header, back link, focused student login card with 6-slot PIN tray and 64px tactile keypad, zero emojis.
Rendered auth.role-select shows clean warm greeting and two direct role cards (Murid / Saya Siswa and Guru / Saya Guru) with soft abstract color bands and zero gimmick text.
Rendered auth.login-teacher shows clean focused teacher login card with Email, Kata Sandi + Lihat toggle, Ingat saya checkbox, and solid green Masuk button.
